title: "Caught exception in launch" but ROS 2 nodes keep running: orphaned nodes after a failed launch, measured
excerpt: When an action fails after nodes started, ros2 launch exits with code 1 and leaves them running: 34 of 34 runs on Humble, 31 of 34 on Jazzy and Lyrical. Killing the launch process group removed them every time; the PR #996 change stopped it. Ctrl+C was clean, SIGTERM was not.
